# https://surrealdb.com/docs/running/cloud

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/running/cloud

[SurrealDB Cloud](https://surrealdb.com/docs/build/deployment/surrealdb-cloud/what-is-surrealdb-cloud) is a managed service: SurrealDB runs in our environment, and you connect from Surrealist, the SDKs, or the HTTP and WebSocket APIs. Compared to the [Surrealist Sandbox](https://surrealdb.com/docs/running/sandbox), you sign in (typically with an email) and your **data persists** in a proper cloud instance.
In Surrealist you can go from the Sandbox to Cloud with **Deploy to Cloud** , create an instance, and then point your connection at the new instance instead of Sandbox.
For day-to-day management of organisations, instances, and billing, use the documentation under **[SurrealDB Cloud](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/cloud)** in the _Manage_ section.
